hooks.command: bash -c 'root="$PWD"; cli=""; while [ "$root" != "/" ] && [ -z "$cli" ]; do for n in data-harness-cli data-harness-cli.exe; do [ -f "$root/bin/$n" ] && cli="$root/bin/$n"; done; root="$(dirname "$root")"; done; if [ -z "$cli" ] && [ -n "$HARNESS_PLUGIN_ROOT" ]; then for n in data-harness-cli data-harness-cli.exe; do [ -f "$HARNESS_PLUGIN_ROOT/bin/$n" ] && cli="$HARNESS_PLUGIN_ROOT/bin/$n"; done; fi; if [ -z "$cli" ]; then echo "QDM_SETUP_REQUIRED: data-harness-cli not found. Run qdm-harness setup with --plugin-root and --data-root." >&2; exit 1; fi; "$cli" context --format codex-hook'
